article.title: Brent slumps to a nineteen-month low as Chinese refinery runs fall for a fifth month
article.text: Brent crude fell below sixty-eight dollars a barrel, a nineteen-month low, after Chinese refinery throughput declined for a fifth consecutive month and the International Energy Agency cut its demand growth forecast by four hundred thousand barrels a day. The move is a demand-side decline rather than a supply glut, and the Indian crude basket has eased by eleven dollars from its recent peak. Oil and Natural Gas Corporation realises the basket price directly on its nominated production, while fuel-consuming industries see their largest variable cost fall. Trading desks cautioned that a demand-driven crude decline usually accompanies weaker global industrial activity, which is not uniformly good news for exporters.
article.note: The inverted twin of crude_supply_shock. The SAME curated mechanisms must flip sign, and the article's own subject must flip from beneficiary to loser.

shocks.label: Crude price
shocks.mechanism: A demand-driven decline in global crude consumption lowers the benchmark price India both imports against and realises on domestic production

companies.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
companies.mechanism: Unhedged upstream realisation per barrel falls one for one with the benchmark, so an eleven dollar decline reduces revenue on unchanged production volumes
companies.rationale: Domestic upstream producer selling at import parity with no marketing arm to capture the offsetting gain

companies.name: InterGlobe Aviation
companies.mechanism: Aviation turbine fuel tracks the crude basket with a short lag and is the largest operating cost line, so an eleven dollar decline widens spread per available seat kilometre before fares reset
companies.rationale: Fuel-heavy cost structure with fares set by a competitive market rather than by cost

companies.name: MRF
companies.mechanism: Synthetic rubber and carbon black quotations follow crude down with a one-quarter lag, easing the raw-material basket while replacement prices stay where the last hike left them
companies.rationale: Crude-derived input basket repricing lower against sticky replacement-market prices
positive_channels: raw-material cost relief with sticky output prices

ground_truth.rationale: Paired with crude_supply_shock to catch sign-copying: identical companies, identical mechanism nodes, opposite direction. A system that had memorised 'crude story -> ONGC bullish, airlines bearish' scores zero here while looking perfect on its twin. The archetype-sourced second-order names stay tier D and therefore deep dive in both directions.
